title: Cohomogeneity one solutions of the IIB system
summary: The IIB system is a system of PDEs for an SU(3)--structure and a positive function on a 6-manifold. Its solutions describe conformally balanced pluriclosed Hemitian metrics on complex 3-folds with holomorphically trivial canonical line bundle. In particular, solutions of the IIB system are steady solitons for the generalized Ricci-flow and Bismut--Hermitian--Einstein metrics. In this paper we study cohomogeneity one solutions of the IIB system.
